'''Prue Canti''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] who operated a [[Prue Canti's greenhouse|greenhouse]] on [[Tenoo]] during the [[High Republic Era|High Republic era]]. Canti had a habit of collecting plants for her greenhouse, believing that she was protecting them. She also owned several droids. On one occasion, she dug up and took a rare [[barelia flower]]. This brought her into conflict with the [[Jedi Initiate]]s [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Nubs]] and [[Linh]], who wanted to return it to its natural spot so that it could bloom at night. Following a brief conflict with the Jedi, Linh managed to convince Canti that the repotted barelia plant was unwell and that it was best to return it to its natural spot. After reconciling, Canti and the Jedi [[youngling]]s watched the barelia flower bloom at night.<ref name="Uprooted" />
